lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The stronghold was armed. I can feel it in the stone; the chapel walls are thicker in this version. A hundred and sixty-four names on a wall that did not exist before. You did that.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You let it fall. I do not blame you; it fell the first time too. But the village is quieter, and the drones count it twice a night now.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You have seen the Quiet now. It is worse in person, isn't it? The Board's people were so ordinary.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The chapel stairs are open whenever you are ready. Take Dax. It is his century, and he should be there when we decide what happens to it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You speak of the Steward as if it could be argued with. Perhaps. I have never heard it answer.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Dax has you talking like a Cinder. Be careful. Burning the models burns the people who are kept alive by them.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Rest if you need it. The monastery asks nothing of anyone.
